facts.text: Keep the coffee coming and the bill on the table. I like to be able to leave the diner quickly.
facts.why: Neil McCauley does not say this in the film. His famous line is about not getting attached to anything you cannot walk out on in thirty seconds. I could not open a quote page to confirm wording, so no real quote is suggested.
facts.fix: Table by the window, bill on the table. I want a clear view of the door.

facts.text: Charlene on the balcony, letting Chris walk away
facts.why: Wikipedia has Charlene at the LAPD safe house warning Chris off. A balcony is not in the plot or transcript, so the line keeps only the safe house.
facts.fix: Charlene at the safe house, warning Chris away
